finding.headline: "The 10-Bottle Graveyard"
finding.problem: "I bought a whole set because the checklist said 8–10 bottles. My baby won't take the nipple. Now I have a drawer of expensive bottles I can't use and no money left."
finding.person: Mum who stocked 10 bottles of one brand pre-birth; baby has tongue-tie / prefers a different nipple; all 10 useless.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Module (bottle-buying: start with 2–4) / Angle.". Verdict: PASSES (4/5).
